For each new element, I’ll add it to the running total, then subtract the value at the position n/2 elements before it (if n is even) or the position (n-1)/2 elements before it (if n is odd). This will give me the sum of all subarrays that end at the current position and start at some position before it. I’ll then add this sum to my running total and return it when I’m done. ```python class Solution: def sumOddLengthSubarrays(self, arr: List[int]) -> int: n = len(arr) running_total = 0 for i in range(n): running_total += sum(arr[:i+1]) if i % 2 == 0: running_total -= sum(arr[i//2]) else: running_total -= sum(arr[(i-1)//2]) return running_total ``` That’s my solution.
